attempts.response: NO_IMPROVEMENT — `llvm.fshl i32 %0,%0,%1` is a rotate-left by `n & 31` and lowers to a single `rol r32, cl` (plus moves for the SysV calling convention and `ret` = 4 instructions). Any `shl/lshr+or` or `and/sub` sequence needs >=2 variable shifts and an `or`/`sub`/`and`, and any BMI2/AVX `shlx/shrx`/`vprold` alternative still needs `cl`/`xmm` moves, so it cannot beat 1 uop `rol` in latency or throughput on Skylake; the measured 2.09 cycles is the lower bound for a variable rotate.
